source: NSE official corporate filings (XBRL) — Financial Results (Reg 33) + Shareholding Pattern (Reg 31), fetched via the nse python package v3.2.1 hitting nseindia.com / nsearchives.nseindia.com directly. No third-party/paid data used.
data_notes: Field names are standardized (see SCHEMA.md) — mapped from whichever raw XBRL tag that filing's taxonomy vintage uses, so the same field name works across all years/companies.
Any real financial fact not yet in the canonical map is kept under 'other_facts' on the same block rather than dropped — this is a standardized schema, not a lossy one.
Balance sheet and cash flow are only disclosed by SEBI LODR at half-year (Q2) and full-year (Q4/Annual) filings — Q1/Q3 having none is expected, not missing data.
cash_flow under each quarter is YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative as filed (H1 for Q2, full year for Q4/Annual), never single-quarter — see its own 'period' field.
'annual' is the separately-filed AUDITED full-year result, distinct from the Q4 quarterly filing — both kept since they can differ.

fii_holding_pct/dii_holding_pct are summed from category sub-fields whose names vary by taxonomy vintage (including a real SEBI taxonomy typo, 'Catergory', in older filings) — the full raw 'categories' dict is always kept alongside for verification.

dii_holding_pct falls back to summing Mutual Funds/Banks/Insurance/Pension Fund categories individually when a filing has no single 'InstitutionsDomestic' aggregate tag (older filings) — treat as an approximation for those years.
Dividend-per-share, analyst estimates, and peer/sector data are not present — none exist in these 2 official sources (see REQUIRED_FIELDS.md / DATA_SOURCES.md).
Some quarters/annual blocks were back-filled by fill_missing_quarters.py from NSE legacy Financial Results and Integrated Filing- Financials XBRL (see 'source_filing' on those blocks).

other_facts.RemarksForDebtEquityRatio:
Debt Equity ratio is calculated considering Total Liabilities as at Dec 31, 2025 i.e 5929.34 millions and Total Equity i.e Shareholders Funds i.e 7956.52 millions.
This ratio is calculated for the year to date 9 months period April to Dec 31, 2025.
other_facts.RemarksForDebtServiceCoverageRatio:
Debt Service Coverage Ratio is calculated considering EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, taxes, Depreciation & Amortization) i.e 1263.48 millions
and Debt Service which includes Borrowings paid during the period April to Dec 31, 2025 which is 3568.91 millions and Finance cost as per Profit and Loss Account which is 207.62 millions and total is 3776.53 millions.
This ratio is calculated for the year to date 9 months period April to Dec 31, 2025.
other_facts.RemarksForInterestServiceCoverageRatio:
Interest Service Coverage ratio is calculated considering EBIT (Earnings Before Interest and Taxes) i.e 701.74 millions divided by Interest cost which is the Finance cost reflecting in profit & loss account i.e 207.62 millions.
This ratio is calculated for the year to date 9 months period April to Dec 31, 2025.

other_facts.NoteForNonApplicabilityOfTheDisclosureFo: There is no default of loans and debt securities, hence not applicable to the entity.
other_facts.RemarksForDebtEquityRatio:
Debt Equity ratio is calculated considering Total Liabilities as at Dec 31, 2025 which is 809.28 millions divided by Shareholders Equity which is 4708.10 millions.
The ratio is calculated year to date for the period April to Dec 31, 2025.
other_facts.RemarksForDebtServiceCoverageRatio:
Debt Service Coverage Ratio is calculated considering EBITDA and Debt Service.
EBITDA is Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization which is 570.78 millions and Debt Service is borrowings paid during the period April to Dec 31, 2025 i.e 99.96 millions and Interest cost in profit and loss account i.e 19.49 millions.
other_facts.RemarksForInterestServiceCoverageRatio:
Interest Service Coverage ratio is calculated considering EBIT divided by Interest cost.
EBIT is Earnings before Interest and Taxes which is 418.88 millions.
Interest cost is Finance cost in profit and Loss account which is 19.49 millions.
